newsitem.title: CHINA: China ships 2.0 mln tonnes of Jilin corn to south.
newsitem.headline: China ships 2.0 mln tonnes of Jilin corn to south.

text.p: China's main corn producing region of Jilin province in the northeast shipped 2.0 million tonnes of corn to southern areas at the end of last year, the China Business Daily said on Tuesday.
The corn was shipped between September 15 and November 25 on orders from the State Council, or cabinet, to take pressure off state grain reserves in Jilin that were full, the newspaper said.

Purchasing areas had lost 100-300 yuan ($12-$36) per tonne in the deal because buying prices in the south were around 1,300 yuan a tonne while transport costs had pushed costs of the corn to more than 1,500 yuan a tonne, it said
The corn had been shipped to 17 provinces and cities including Beijing, Shanghai, and the provinces of Hunan, Hubei, Guangdong and Hainan, it said without giving further details.
China produced about 119 million tonnes of corn in 1996, up from 111.986 million tonnes the year before, official estimates show. Jilin's output was more that 17.5 million tonnes.
